In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the carrier dynamics of high quality MBE grown InAs epilayer is very complex and depends on many factors, such as carrier density, excitation intensity, temperature, and sample thickness.
this is the most complete and detailed study of the recombination dynamics in InAs to date.
the carrier lifetime and intraband carrier relaxation time are both of the same order of magnitude in InAs epilayer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the carrier dynamics in InAs epilayer are dominated by Auger recombination, and intraband carrier scattering is the fastest relaxation process.
the carrier recombination rates are dominated by recombination to the heterointerface, and that carrier intraband dynamics are dominated by scattering.
the carrier recombination rates in InAs are comparable to those in GaAs, while the carrier scattering times are shorter than in GaAs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the carrier recombination and scattering dynamics in high-quality MBE InAs are similar to those of other III-V semiconductors.
InAs is an ideal material for studying carrier recombination dynamics and intraband relaxation in a wide range of pump intensities and photon energies.
high quality MBE InAs is an ideal system for studying intraband carrier dynamics in a semiconductor with an indirect bandgap.
